meta.subject: Geometry
meta.objective: Explain why a² + b² = c² for a right triangle and use it to find a missing side.

steps.title: A right triangle
steps.say: Start with a right triangle. One corner is exactly ninety degrees.

steps.title: The legs
steps.say: The two shorter sides are called the legs. We name them a and b.

steps.title: The hypotenuse
steps.say: The longest side, across from the right angle, is the hypotenuse. We call it c.

steps.title: Squares on each side
steps.say: Now build a square on each side of the triangle.

steps.title: Compare the areas
steps.say: Color them in. The two small squares together cover exactly as much area as the big one.

steps.title: Try 3 and 4
steps.say: Try a triangle with legs of three and four. Three squared is nine. Four squared is sixteen.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: Before we add them, predict: how long is side c? Pause and think.

steps.title: Add them up
steps.say: Nine plus sixteen is twenty-five. So the big square is twenty-five, and its side c is five.

steps.title: The rule
steps.say: That is the Pythagorean theorem. a squared plus b squared equals c squared.
